leadText:
Fulfilling Our Dreams (Korean: 꿈을 이룰거야 Kkumeul Irulgeoya) is the opening theme for the 2017 Korean redubbing of Celebi: Voice of the Forest. It is performed by Kwon Ayeong.

The song was uploaded to the composer's YouTube channel on January 23, 2022.
plainText:
Fulfilling Our Dreams (Korean: 꿈을 이룰거야 Kkumeul Irulgeoya) is the opening theme for the 2017 Korean redubbing of Celebi: Voice of the Forest. It is performed by Kwon Ayeong.

The song was uploaded to the composer's YouTube channel on January 23, 2022.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

Whether it is through water, fire or forest
I can search endlessly
If I can meet you at that place

We can fulfill our dreams
If you and I are together
The power we raised together
We can fly even higher

For the dazzling tomorrow
If you and I are together
The world's strongest Pokémon Master
Can't stop us

Even today I'm running
Whether it is above the sky or inside the earth
I can search endlessly
If I can meet you at that place

We can fulfill our dreams
If you and I are together
The power we raised together
We can fly even higher

For the dazzling tomorrow
If you and I are together
The world's strongest Pokémon Master
Can't stop us

Although we can't know when
Our sincerity will someday shine

We can fulfill our dreams
If you and I are together
The power we raised together
We can fly even higher

For the dazzling tomorrow
If you and I are together
The world's strongest Pokémon Master
Don't give up. We will certainly fulfill our dreams
 

==Video==
